object.description: Setup M: physical Android device with a mock location app selected, fine location permission granted, distance unit kilometre, fixes injected once per second along 59.3000 N moving east. Steps: 1. Select Walk and Start. 2. Inject fixes at 1.3 m/s until the timer reads 30:00. 3. Select Finish and read Calories. 4. Repeat with Hike for 20:00. Expected: Walk reads 129 kcal (128 to 130). Hike reads 147 kcal (146 to 148).
